name: loom
description: A self-maintaining docs and context harness for keeping repository documentation lean, routed, and agent-useful.

interface.longDescription: Loom bundles documentation-focused Codex skills plus a SessionStart context slicer so agents enter a repository with targeted bearings instead of stale or bloated docs.
defaultPrompt: Use loom to review this repo's docs
Run loom's doc linter and fix drift
Slice the docs for current context
